name: BACH_0097
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (>99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
The conformal set, second model and 5/5 similar cases all point to Invasive [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%; others <1% | One class dominates |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | Not flagged as suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Neighbors fully agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept association with invasive carcinoma · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 8) · ↑ invasive · Score high, but failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Scarce gland / tubule formation** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score; tubules associate with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↑ invasive · Nuclear atypia associated with invasive carcinoma · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 2, 3, 7) · context · 88% neoplastic nuclei, top of reference range · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so they are not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitotic figures, which this case leans on, are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Concept evidence is untested against the classifier, and the mitoses score failed its spot check.
- Cell measurements cover only regions 2, 3 and 7; other regions are unsampled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 3:** Confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 8:** Count mitoses yourself; the model score failed its spot check.
3. **Region 0:** Confirm gland/tubule formation is scarce and nuclei are markedly pleomorphic.
